ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-24-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, VJ: Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maureen Howard.
Petitioners: Ze Jing Zhen and Qiao Yu Situ, are present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Hui Juan Zhen and with Cantonese Interpreter: Charles Zheng.
Petitioners and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Cindy Zhen.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-24-2007 Reset To May-24-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Denise Doucette.
Petitioner: Ze Jing Zhen not present, requested for a continuance via correspondence.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
The Court grants the request and continued the OSC to May 24, 2007 at 9:00 A.M. in Dept. 218, and waived Re-Publication of OSC.
